_comment: UI drift audit thresholds for KE. Baseline captured 2026-04-25 (Stream C1 - design-system migration to @venturecrane/tokens/ke.css). KE's Next.js app layout puts sources under app/src - the src_dirs override targets that. Pre-existing 9 raw hex/rgb in JSX and 4 raw Tailwind color classes are baseline; this PR introduces no new drift. Inline-style hex/rgb is hard-zero (already at zero on main). Subsequent design-debt PRs ratchet thresholds toward 0.
